run_setup_install: run setup.py to install the flsim federated learning simulator package and its dependencies
run_setup_check_python: run setup.py to check that the installed python version meets the minimum requirement of 3.6.8
run_setup_list_deps: run setup.py to list the install requirements from requirements.txt for the flsim package
review_setup_metadata: review the setup.py metadata including author, description, license, and keywords for the flsim package
summarize_setup_config: summarize the setuptools configuration for the flsim package including version, classifiers, and extras
